## Summary

Describe the change and its motivation.

## Research integrity checklist

- [ ] Features use only information available at the decision timestamp.
- [ ] Overlapping forward labels are purged from validation boundaries.
- [ ] Trading costs and execution timing are explicit.
- [ ] Relevant static and blended baselines are included.
- [ ] New behavior is tested.
- [ ] No credentials or non-redistributable data are committed.
